issues.description: Function 'ray_sphere_intersect' has inconsistent parameter lists across repository artifacts. In template/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h the prototype declares three parameters: (const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center). However, the template implementation in example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp defines the function with four parameters (const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius), and the template call site in example_program/src/main.cpp passes four arguments (origin_f, dirn, center, radius2). The solution repository header also declares the four-parameter signature. This header/implementation mismatch in the template will cause compilation errors and will confuse students about the correct API to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template header declaration to match the implementation and solution. Change the prototype in example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h to: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius); Ensure the declaration's parameter types and order exactly match the implementation and the call sites.
